variant.title: Entropy Sudoku
variant.description: Every adjacent 2x2 window must contain low, middle, and high digits.
rule.entropy: Every adjacent 2x2 window must contain at least one low, one middle, and one high digit.
rule_guide.title: Entropy Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: Digits are split into three bands: low digits 1, 2, 3; middle digits 4, 5, 6; and high digits 7, 8, 9.
rule_guide.item_2: Every adjacent 2x2 window must contain at least one digit from each of the three bands.
rule_guide.item_3: For example, 1 4 / 7 2 follows the rule. The window 1 2 / 4 5 does not because it has no high digit.
